scope: Bounded horizontal normal AAT tracking in Drawing and ordinary embedded TrueType PDF text; prerequisite evidence, not NASA or H10 acceptance.
contracts: Nominal glyph metrics and embedded PDF widths remain unchanged.
Run measurement and painting apply size-dependent normal tracking once per painted grapheme cluster.
Positive and signed RTL runs preserve attached glyph offsets; ligatures count as their painted cluster.
Raster export scale changes geometry while retaining the authored tracking evaluation size.
The optional HarfBuzz adapter excludes trak from its shaping face; the owned layout applies tracking.
Standard, named, explicit-direction positioned and embedded/fallback form PDF paths use the same tracking-aware commands.

systemUiExplicitInstance.limitation: Only the explicit optical-size-17 instance at authored size 16 is matched here; generic-family mapping and automatic per-size selection remain unimplemented.

priorCoreTrackingCandidate.boundary: Before the mechanically shared grapheme helper and PDF integration; final shared helper is additionally covered by focused Drawing and full PDF checks.

beforePdfTracking.cases: Sizes 10 and 15 measured nominal widths before the implementation; size 20 had zero normal tracking and already passed.

reviewFindingsBeforeFix.cases: Four standard/named LTR/RTL positioned measurements and one negative attached-mark cluster failed; positive attachment passed.

regressionReproduction.reviewDisposition: Both PDF findings fixed and validated; one targeted read-only confirmation reported no actionable findings.

renderedEvidence.signedAndDirectedFixture: Synthetic independent marker font; manually positioned untracked references test geometry. Directed fixture uses internal scene construction and public PDF authoring.
renderedEvidence.textExtraction: Poppler retains AB in direct/directed/form documents and A plus combining acute plus B in the signed fixture.
renderedEvidence.residual: Carlito Drawing-to-PDF differs by 66 pixels from independent placement because of existing rounded nominal PDF metrics and run fitting. This is not exact visual parity.

cleanup: Task-created probe bin/obj and optional HarfBuzz test bin/obj removed; compact sources, PDF/PNG comparisons and measurements retained.
